product_one_liner.value: Scandit provides smart data capture software that uses cameras on smart devices to scan barcodes, text, IDs and objects, helping businesses in retail, logistics, healthcare and manufacturing automate frontline workflows.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes fixed and flexible pricing and Core, Standard and Advanced editions; numeric prices require a quote.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts within the main blog, rather than a separate engineering publication: CTO Christian Floerkemeier explains the Vision AI Engine’s models and on-device architecture, and the design and implementation choices behind SparkScan.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Biometrics & Face Recognition), Tampere, published 2026-10-08.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed product documentation, AI information, security, technical blog and subprocessors. Scandit describes its Vision AI Engine and on-device ML/VLM processing but does not identify a specific underlying model or model provider. Coding-agent compatibility and infrastructure subprocessors do not establish the scanning product’s model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO 27001:2022 is explicitly certified; GDPR is explicitly claimed as regulatory compliance, not a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly reported round was announced 2022-02-09, before the 2025-05-09–2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting: Business Development Representative – French Speaker, London, published 2026-10-27.

launched_6mo.notes: Scandit announced Self-Checkout Loss Prevention on 2026-09-15, within the 2026-05-09–2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tom Karrat’s profile dates his start as Chief Revenue Officer to January 2026, within the 2025-11-09–2026-11-09 window; the management page lists him on the leadership team.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Key Account Manager posting explicitly lists these systems as its sales technology stack.
